article.title: QT4 extensions
article.aside: The use of new 4.0 features requires Saxon-PE or higher.
article.p: A W3C Community Group is working on proposals for extensions to XPath, XSLT, and XQuery, and has produced a version 4.0 set of specifications. Details are at https://qt4cg.org.
Saxon 13 implements many of the new features in these drafts. Specifically, the Saxon 13.0 release aims to conform to the stable drafts dated 28 January 2026.

In other cases, Saxon has implemented proposed features that the community group has not yet agreed. In addition, the draft specifications are constantly changing. So the specifications are only an approximate guide to what is implemented in Saxon.

From Saxon 13, it is no longer necessary to explicitly enable the use of 4.0 features, they are available as standard for Saxon-PE and Saxon-EE.
article.aside: In earlier versions of Saxon, the experimental 4.0 features implemented are not available unless they are explicitly enabled. In particular by setting the configuration property , setting the language level to 4.0 in a call to an API method such as XsltCompiler.setXsltLanguageVersion(), or setting the language level to 4.0 in a XQuery declaration (or using the option -qversion:4.0 on the command line).
article.p: FIXME: Generally, Saxonica aims to avoid making incompatible changes except in major releases. But the features described in this section are experimental, so this policy does not apply: the aim instead will be to respond rapidly to changes in the developing specification.

Further information and details of the current Saxon implementation has been integrated into the relevant sections of this documentation. Content is highlighted (like this page) to indicate details about QT4 features, using the QT4 lightbulb image. The main sections with new information are as follows:

ul.li: XSLT elements reference - for details on all new 4.0 XSLT instructions, and 4.0 extensions to existing elements
XPath syntax reference - updated to include information on 4.0 extensions, including new types, new expressions, new function syntax
Function library reference - for details on all new 4.0 functions, and information about changes to existing functions
Standards conformance - for detailed information on the conformance and restrictions of the Saxon implementation for the specific 4.0 language specifications
